settingsPanelDisabled.description: Indicates if the settings panel is not available

title.description: Chart title configuration. Not read by this element: `titlePlaceholder` sets the title's placeholder.

instruction.description: Author instruction to build a new chart; `label` is the text shown above the form

authorNewCategoryDefaults.description: Configuration for new category in define chart

chartDimensions.description: Chart dimensions the author can set

studentNewCategoryDefaultLabel.description: Not read by this element: the model's `studentNewCategoryDefaultLabel` labels the categories students add

maxImageWidth.description: Maximum image width for input fields

maxImageHeight.description: Maximum image height for input fields

withRubric.description: Rubric configuration - only relevant in environments that use pie-player-components

availableChartTypes.description: Indicates the chart types that are available

chartTypeLabel.description: Indicates the label for the chart type

labelsCharactersLimit.description: Indicates the maximum character limit for X and Y axis labels

languageChoices.description: Language choices configuration Only available if language is enabled

showPrompt.description: Not read by this element: the model's `promptEnabled` shows the prompt

promptLabel.description: Not read by this element: `prompt.label` labels the prompt

settingsPartialScoring.description: Not read by this element: `scoringType.settings` shows the scoring control

customPlugins.description: An array of objects that determine custom plugins. A custom plugin is an object which determines how the button will look like (icon) and the event name that will be triggered when the button gets pressed (event).

EditableHtmlConfigureProp.description: Toolbar plugins of an editable-html field, keyed by plugin name.

disabled.description: Indicates if the plugin is disabled or not

event.description: The name of the custom event. It needs to be valid (only letters, numbers and "_" can be used). The event is emitted with the "PIE-" prefix.

iconAlt.description: The alt for the custom button icon

iconType.description: The icon type. Currently, only "SVG" is supported.

icon.description: The icon string. Currently, only SVG is supported, so it needs to be a valid svg.

settings.description: Indicates if the item has to be displayed in the Settings Panel

label.description: Indicates the label for the item that has to be displayed in the Settings Panel

required.description: Indicates if the item is required and the value cannot be empty

label.description: Indicates the label for the item that has to be displayed in the Settings Panel

enabled.description: Indicates the value of the item if it affects config-ui (eg.: if item is a switch and displaying an input on the config-ui depends on the switch value: on/off)

label.description: Indicates the label for the item that has to be displayed in the Settings Panel

ConfigureProp.description:
Building blocks of an element's authoring configuration: the object a host passes to the `<tag>-config` custom element to decide which settings the author sees and how editors behave.

Each element declares its own `<Name>Configuration` interface from these, and its JSON Schema is generated from that interface. Descriptions are carried over from the legacy `pie-elements` config schemas, so they appear in the generated schemas unchanged.

top.description: This value is empty for charting. The property exist in order to be consistent with graphing configuration.

right.description: This value is empty for charting. The property exist in order to be consistent with graphing configuration.

bottom.description: Indicates the placeholder for the bottom label

left.description: Indicates the placeholder for the left label

label.description: Indicates the label for the new category

interactive.description: Indicates if new category is interactive

editable.description: Indicates if new category is editable

showInConfigPanel.description: Shows the chart width and height controls

width.description: Width the author can set: `min` at least 50, `max` at most 700, `step` at most 200; 50, 700 and 20 when absent

height.description: Height the author can set: `min` at least 400, `max` at most 700, `step` at most 200; 400, 700 and 20 when absent

ChartingDimensions.description: Chart dimensions the author can set

min.description: Smallest value the author can set

max.description: Largest value the author can set

step.description: Step of the control; values under 1 count as 20

ChartingDimensionConstraints.description: Range of a chart dimension the author can set

mmlOutput.description: Indicates if model should have mathML output instead of latex

mmlEditing.description: Indicates if mathML that's already in model should be editable

teacherInstructions.description: Indicates the max dimension for images in teacher instructions

prompt.description: Indicates the max dimension for images in prompt - this is also the default dimension for all other input fields if it's not specified

rationale.description: Indicates the max dimension for images in rationale

ConfigureMaxImageDimensionsProp.description: Maximum image dimensions per editable field. Elements extend it with their own fields.

changeInteractive.description: Indicates if teacher can enable/disable data[]:interactive

changeEditable.description: Indicates if teacher can enable/disable data[]:editable

addCategory.description: Indicates if teacher can enable/disable addCategoryEnabled

mathMlOptions.description: Not read by this element: the configuration's top-level `mathMlOptions` applies

settings.description: Indicates if the item has to be displayed in the Settings Panel

authoringLabel.description: Indicates the label for the option

settingsLabel.description: Indicates the label for the item that has to be displayed in the Settings Panel

bar.description: Indicates if bar chart is available and the label used for it.

histogram.description: Indicates if histogram is available and the label used for it.

lineDot.description: Indicates if line chart with dots is available and the label used for it.

lineCross.description: Indicates if line chart with crosses is available and the label used for it.

dotPlot.description: Indicates if dot plot is available and the label used for it.

linePlot.description: Indicates if line plot is available and the label used for it.

ChartingAvailableChartTypes.description: Indicates the chart types that are available and the label used for each; a type without a label is not offered

ContentDimensions.description: Indicates the dimensions configuration for the authoring container. Note: Some items have a default minimum width because of their content, but if a lower minWidth is provided, it will be used.
